title: About
text:
About Me

I’m a Computer Science student at Brigham Young University Idaho, set to graduate in December 2027 with an emphasis in Software Engineering and Cyber Security. I’m interested in building well-structured, maintainable software and enjoy the process of taking a project from a rough idea to a finished, working product.
Outside of coursework, I like exploring game development as a creative outlet, currently working on a Unity-based dungeon crawler with custom enemy types, sound, and pixel art. I also enjoy tactical strategy games, which has turned into a hobby of building and testing systems in Football Manager.

Software Engineering Game Development Data Analysis Algorithms Cyber Security C# Python Unity
